run_sacred_log_example: run the sacred log_example script to demonstrate custom logging with an Experiment
create_sacred_experiment_with_custom_log: create a sacred Experiment and attach a custom logger with a StreamHandler and Formatter
configure_sacred_experiment_with_config_: configure a sacred Experiment using the @ex.config decorator to define config variables
capture_config_values_with_ex_capture: capture config values and the _log object in a function using the @ex.capture decorator
